milestones.title: 01 - Foundation
milestones.goal: Record the scope and architecture; prepare a local development foundation.

milestones.title: 02 - Prototype and AI pilot
milestones.goal: Review option 1 as an interactive prototype and measure answer quality, speed and cost.

milestones.title: 03 - Accounts and access
milestones.goal: Provide invitation-based accounts and enforce customer and administrator permissions.

milestones.title: 04 - Private chats and sharing
milestones.goal: Persist private history and support explicit, revocable sharing with Helle.

milestones.title: 05 - Packages and usage
milestones.goal: Implement customer allowances, cost accounting and enforceable limits.

milestones.title: 06 - Production AI integration
milestones.goal: Connect the authenticated product to governed knowledge and reliable AI responses.

milestones.title: 07 - Privacy and data lifecycle
milestones.goal: Implement privacy operations and document the necessary legal and supplier arrangements.

milestones.title: 08 - Verification and launch
milestones.goal: Verify security and performance, run a private pilot and prepare operations.

milestones.title: Later - Optional extensions
milestones.goal: Optional work outside the first release; schedule only if needed.

tasks.title: Document the agreed scope and open decisions
tasks.deliverable: Project requirements and a decision register grounded in the two proposals and selected option 1.
acceptance: Record individual customers, external payment, invited accounts, private history, explicit sharing, packages and administrator controls.
Record unresolved materials, data sensitivity, traffic, retention, provider ownership and pricing; label speed figures as unmeasured targets.

tasks.title: Choose and record the application architecture
tasks.deliverable: A short architecture decision covering frontend, backend, database, authentication, email and EU hosting candidates.
acceptance: Compare a TypeScript web app, PostgreSQL and mature authentication against the selected design and deployment requirements; record the choice and trade-offs.
Define server-only API calls, ownership enforcement, secrets, development/staging/production boundaries and vendor decisions still awaiting confirmation.

tasks.title: Scaffold the local application and environment setup
tasks.deliverable: A runnable local application with setup instructions and environment examples.
acceptance: The app starts from a documented command, has a health check and handles missing configuration clearly.
Secrets and temporary files are excluded from Git; environment examples contain names and placeholders only.

tasks.title: Define the option 1 design system
tasks.deliverable: Reusable colours, typography, spacing, controls and responsive rules based on the selected mockup.
acceptance: The approved option 1 layout uses a black-and-white palette with neutral gray surfaces, grayscale branding and measured text/control contrast (client update: 18 October 2026).
Buttons, inputs, focus, error, loading, disabled and mobile states are documented; Danish is the customer UI language.

tasks.title: Create synthetic demo data and a mock AI provider
tasks.deliverable: Fictional customers, conversations, plans and deterministic simulated responses.
acceptance: The prototype can run without credentials, external email or real customer data.
Mock mode is visibly identifiable and can simulate streaming, delay, cancellation, failure and exhausted allowance without being enabled accidentally in production.

tasks.title: Set up development checks and continuous integration
tasks.deliverable: Repeatable lint, type, build and meaningful test checks.
acceptance: Pull requests run the selected checks using locked dependencies.
A documented test setup supports authentication, ownership and ledger tests; no real customer content or secrets are used in CI.

tasks.title: Build the customer workspace from option 1
tasks.deliverable: Responsive customer chat shell with sidebar, history, privacy status and composer.
acceptance: Desktop layout is compared visually with the selected mockup; mobile navigation and keyboard access work.
The core visible controls work with mock data and empty, loading and error states are coherent.

tasks.title: Implement the chat interaction prototype
tasks.deliverable: Interactive mock chat including new chats, history selection, send, streaming, stop and copy.
acceptance: A user can complete the main writing journey and continue a previous synthetic chat.
Delayed, cancelled and failed responses have clear UI states; draft text survives recoverable errors.

tasks.title: Prototype administration, sharing and usage screens
tasks.deliverable: Mock account list, invitation form, package editor, usage view and sharing preview.
acceptance: Invitation, package assignment, suspension and sharing flows can be demonstrated using synthetic data.
The admin view exposes account and usage metadata but no unshared conversation titles or messages; mock prices are labelled illustrative.

tasks.title: Provision a dedicated OpenAI development project securely
inputs: OpenAI account/project owner and credential destination
tasks.deliverable: A server-side development credential and documented project controls.
acceptance: Use the supported credential setup flow; keep secrets out of chat, source, browser and logs and separate development from production.
Confirm accessible models, rate limits, spend controls and regional/retention eligibility; record unresolved requirements rather than assuming approval.

tasks.title: Collect assistant materials and an answer-quality test set
inputs: Existing GPT instructions and knowledge files
Approved examples and permitted use of the material
tasks.deliverable: Versioned source material plus representative Danish questions and expected answer criteria.
acceptance: Document the method, scope, tone, source ownership and examples of good and unacceptable answers.
Use synthetic or appropriately redacted cases; private customer chats are not automatically included in shared knowledge or training.

tasks.title: Build a minimal server-side streaming API pilot
tasks.deliverable: An isolated local pilot for text generation, streaming and request usage measurement.
acceptance: Use current supported API behaviour, server-only credentials and explicit retention settings; the browser receives no secrets.
Record time to readable text, completion time and actual usage with synthetic inputs; the pilot is not exposed as an unauthenticated public endpoint.

tasks.title: Prototype retrieval from approved knowledge
tasks.deliverable: A small retrieval experiment using approved assistant material.
acceptance: Retrieve relevant excerpts with source identifiers and bounded context instead of sending the entire knowledge base.
Compare retrieval quality and latency; document storage/deletion implications and keep customer-private data outside the shared collection.

tasks.title: Benchmark quality, speed and operating cost
tasks.deliverable: An evidence-backed model and configuration recommendation.
acceptance: Measure 30-50 representative Danish tasks, short/long histories, warm/cold conditions and initially 1/10/25 concurrent users, adjusted to expected demand.
Report quality, errors, cost, median and p95 time to first readable text and full-answer time separately; assess provisional 2-second median/5-second p95 targets without treating them as guarantees.

tasks.title: Design the database schema and migrations
tasks.deliverable: Schema and migrations for accounts, invitations, chats, messages, shares, knowledge versions, packages and usage records.
acceptance: Ownership and foreign-key constraints are explicit, identifiers are opaque and unique, and deletion relationships are documented.
Migrations can be applied to a fresh development database and recovery/rollback strategy is recorded.

Add projects, prompt identities/immutable versions, unique customer/project assignments and restricted provider configurations; use composite constraints so a prompt cannot be assigned through another project. Conversations pin owner/project/prompt/config versions.

tasks.title: Implement customer and administrator access policies
tasks.deliverable: Deny-by-default backend and database authorization rules.
acceptance: Every object read/write derives the authenticated user and checks ownership or a specific share grant; client-supplied user IDs cannot grant access.
Administrator account management does not confer private-chat access; runtime database roles and jobs do not silently bypass the intended ownership policy.

Enforce active customer/project membership as well as conversation ownership. Shared project membership never grants access to another customer history, and customer responses exclude private instructions/provider secrets.

tasks.title: Integrate authentication and revocable sessions
inputs: Selected authentication and transactional-email provider configuration
tasks.deliverable: Verified customer identity and secure server sessions.
acceptance: Sessions use appropriate secure cookie/token controls, expiration and revocation; state-changing requests receive applicable CSRF protection.
Email change, account recovery and account deletion require identity checks; admins cannot reset credentials into a customer-impersonation path.

tasks.title: Implement invitations and transactional email delivery
tasks.deliverable: Create, resend, revoke, expire and accept invitation operations.
acceptance: Tokens are unguessable, short-lived, single-use, stored safely and bound to the intended account; resending/revoking invalidates previous invitations.
Sending is rate-limited, delivery errors are visible, links are excluded from logs and email content contains no passwords or chat content.

tasks.title: Build activation, sign-in and account recovery screens
tasks.deliverable: Accessible Danish screens for invitation acceptance and email-link sign-in.
acceptance: Valid, expired, revoked, reused and undelivered links produce understandable recovery flows.
Keyboard navigation and mobile layouts work; responses avoid unnecessary account enumeration and preserve safe return destinations.

tasks.title: Build administrator customer management
tasks.deliverable: Account list, invitations, access status, expiry, renewal and suspension.
acceptance: Admins can manage access without viewing private conversation content, titles or exporting it.
Suspension/expiry is enforced on existing sessions and new AI requests; changes are auditable and no login-as-customer function exists.
Allow administrators to grant multiple projects and one published prompt version per customer/project; audit grant, reassignment and revocation without opening unshared conversations.

tasks.title: Require administrator MFA and secure recovery
tasks.deliverable: Enforced MFA and a documented administrative recovery procedure.
acceptance: Administrative actions require the configured stronger authentication level, including a fresh check for sensitive operations.
Recovery is tested and logged without creating a route into customers' private accounts.

tasks.title: Verify authentication and authorization boundaries
tasks.deliverable: Integration tests using at least two customers and an administrator.
acceptance: Test horizontal and vertical access attacks, forged object ownership, token reuse, recovery, suspension and session revocation.
Tests run against real application/database policies, including list, detail and mutation routes, and fail if another customer's data is exposed.

tasks.title: Implement the private conversation data layer
tasks.deliverable: Owner-scoped create, list, read, rename and delete operations for chats and messages.
acceptance: Ownership is checked for every operation, including pagination and search; unauthorized object IDs disclose no private metadata.
Message ordering and request identifiers support concurrent requests and retries without duplicating messages.
Scope history, conversation writes and provider context by authenticated customer and project; preserve immutable prompt/version bindings and block stale assignments.

tasks.title: Connect the customer UI to persistent private history
tasks.deliverable: Real private chat history and account-specific client state.
acceptance: Chats persist across refresh and sign-in, and customers can rename, search and delete their own conversations.
Account switching and sign-out clear sensitive client caches; private responses are not placed in shared/public caches.

tasks.title: Implement explicit shared conversation snapshots
tasks.deliverable: Authenticated, recipient-scoped snapshot sharing with Helle.
acceptance: A share contains exactly the selected messages at creation time; later messages and unrelated chats remain private.
Revocation blocks new reads and cached access; snapshots follow source deletion/retention rules and have no public bearer-link access.

tasks.title: Build share preview, revoke and shared-inbox screens
tasks.deliverable: Customer sharing controls and a separate administrator shared-content inbox.
acceptance: The customer sees the intended recipient and exact content before sharing and can list/revoke grants.
The admin can only open granted snapshots; the UI explains that revocation cannot recall copies already made.

tasks.title: Verify chat isolation and sharing lifecycle
tasks.deliverable: End-to-end tests for private chats, sharing and revocation.
acceptance: Verify isolation for lists, titles, messages, search, pagination and attempted direct URLs.
Verify the snapshot stays fixed, revocation works in an existing session, and source deletion removes access as specified.

tasks.title: Define package, allowance and charging rules
inputs: Package names/prices, reset rules, rollover, top-up expiry and cancellation policy
tasks.deliverable: A clear distinction between customer answer credits and internal token/cost accounting.
acceptance: Define a standard answer, input/output bounds, higher-cost actions, reset timezone, renewal, rollover and prorating behaviour.
Specify failed/cancelled/retried request treatment and price versioning; validate package economics against pilot results and label draft prices as provisional.

tasks.title: Implement the usage ledger and atomic reservations
tasks.deliverable: A transactional ledger for grants, reservations, settlements, releases and adjustments.
acceptance: Concurrent requests cannot overspend a balance; request IDs make replayed operations idempotent.
Crashes, disconnected streams and unknown provider outcomes reconcile safely; uncertain charges are not silently released or billed twice.

Tag reservations and ledger events with project and prompt/config version; project switching never resets a customer allowance. Confirm whether production packages are shared or per-project before enforcing commercial rules.

tasks.title: Record token usage and reconcile provider cost
tasks.deliverable: Per-request usage and estimated cost records without message bodies.
acceptance: Capture actual provider usage, cache categories, reasoning and tools with no double counting, and preserve the relevant model/rate version.
Separate estimates from settled usage and reconcile against provider billing, including retries and incomplete streaming usage.

tasks.title: Build package administration and manual entitlements
tasks.deliverable: Manage plans, assignments, renewals, expiries and one-time top-ups after external payment.
acceptance: Package edits do not silently rewrite existing purchased entitlements; changes and adjustments have an audit trail.
A non-sensitive external payment reference can be recorded and duplicate entitlement grants are prevented; no card processing is introduced.

tasks.title: Build customer and administrator usage views
tasks.deliverable: Remaining allowance, renewal date, warning states and privacy-preserving usage summaries.
acceptance: Customer totals match the ledger; exhausted/expired packages have clear next steps to obtain access externally.
Admins see relevant usage/cost metadata without private message text or conversation titles; per-user data is appropriately access-controlled.

tasks.title: Enforce per-user rate, concurrency and spending limits
tasks.deliverable: Application-level abuse controls and total spend protection.
acceptance: Check user allowance, access, maximum input/output, concurrent requests and applicable budget before a provider request.
Test warning thresholds, hard-cap behaviour, recovery and queue limits; provider project caps are documented as a secondary safeguard.

tasks.title: Verify billing and allowance correctness under concurrency
tasks.deliverable: Meaningful ledger and entitlement tests.
acceptance: Cover parallel tabs, duplicate events, renewals, expiry, top-ups, rollover, plan changes and clock boundaries.
Inject timeouts, cancellation, failed settlements and worker crashes; verify invariants and reconcile provider charges without duplicate customer deductions.

tasks.title: Implement the authenticated production AI gateway
tasks.deliverable: A server-only generation path integrated with identity, ownership and reservations.
acceptance: Authorize the account and conversation and reserve allowance before calling OpenAI; secrets and privileged tools never reach the client.
Use the chosen model/region and verified retention settings; disabled accounts and exhausted limits cannot bypass checks through alternate routes.

Resolve the approved provider connection and pinned prompt content server-side from the authenticated assignment. Reject cross-project prompt references and revoked/stale requests; keep credentials and real instructions out of the browser.

tasks.title: Implement administrator knowledge ingestion and publication
tasks.deliverable: Admin-only ingestion, indexing, source tracking and deletion of approved knowledge.
acceptance: Validate supported file types and sizes, process safely, record provenance and show ingestion failures clearly.
Draft material is separated from published knowledge; replacing/deleting sources removes stale retrieval entries and provider files where applicable.

tasks.title: Implement bounded conversation context and safe retrieval
tasks.deliverable: Relevant knowledge and owner-scoped conversation context within explicit budgets.
acceptance: Long histories are bounded or summarised under the same ownership and deletion rules; no cross-customer memory or private-response cache is shared.
Retrieved text and user input are treated as untrusted content and cannot alter authorization or access other users' information; source references are retained.

tasks.title: Version assistant instructions and evaluate changes
tasks.deliverable: Draft, test, publish and rollback workflow for assistant behaviour.
acceptance: Changes are evaluated against approved Danish examples and safety/quality criteria before production publication.
The deployed model, prompt and knowledge versions are identifiable and rollback is demonstrated; implementation follows currently supported OpenAI interfaces.

Use immutable application-owned prompt versions with source provenance and evaluated publication. Import existing Platform prompt objects according to AK-061; membership changes are explicit and never silently rewrite chats.

tasks.title: Integrate reliable streaming, cancellation and recovery
tasks.deliverable: A complete streamed-response lifecycle with correct persistence and accounting.
acceptance: Partial output, cancellation, disconnects, provider limits and timeouts produce consistent UI, message and ledger states.
Retries are bounded and idempotent at the application level, and never silently duplicate generated messages or customer charges.

tasks.title: Secure AI output rendering and browser interactions
tasks.deliverable: Safe rendering of assistant text, formatting, links and copy actions.
acceptance: Untrusted HTML, scripts and dangerous link schemes cannot execute through model output or pasted content.
Browser security controls, input limits and accessibility are verified; no external-content fetching or tools are enabled without an explicit product need.

tasks.title: Verify the complete assistant workflow
tasks.deliverable: An integrated acceptance run for invitation, private chat, usage and shared knowledge.
acceptance: An active customer can obtain a grounded answer, resume history and consume allowance correctly; other users' content never appears.
Check Danish answer quality, uncertainty handling, unsupported questions, long conversations and failure states using the approved evaluation cases.
Include the overlapping-user/multi-project isolation and reassignment verification from AK-062 before calling the real assistant workflow complete.

tasks.title: Map personal data, purposes and retention rules
inputs: Permitted data types and lawful bases
tasks.deliverable: A data inventory and retention/deletion matrix.
acceptance: Cover account data, chats, shared snapshots, summaries, files, embeddings, usage records, email, logs and backups with purpose, recipient and storage location.
Determine permitted sensitive-data use, lawful bases and DPIA requirements with the responsible privacy reviewer; distinguish deletion from required record retention.

tasks.title: Implement customer export and access-request handling
tasks.deliverable: Authenticated data export and a process for verified access requests.
acceptance: Exports contain the requesting customer's relevant data and no other customer's private content; downloads expire and are access-controlled.
A verified request route remains usable after commercial access expires, with request tracking and a documented response procedure.

tasks.title: Implement deletion and retention jobs across data stores
tasks.deliverable: Chat/account erasure and scheduled retention enforcement.
acceptance: Delete or appropriately retain records across primary data, shares, summaries, indexes, caches, exports and provider objects; document exceptions and provider retention limits.
Jobs are idempotent and observable; backup expiry and deletion replay after restoration prevent deleted data from silently reappearing.

tasks.title: Add content-free audit logs and privacy-safe telemetry
tasks.deliverable: Auditable access, administrative, sharing and usage events without private chat contents.
acceptance: Record necessary actor/action/time/result metadata with restricted access and documented retention.
Redact keys, tokens and customer content from errors and traces; verify analytics, session recording and third-party telemetry cannot collect private chats.

tasks.title: Prepare privacy notices, terms and customer rights flows
inputs: Reviewed legal text and privacy contact
tasks.deliverable: Reviewed customer disclosures and implemented rights/contact entry points.
acceptance: Explain AI processing, recipients, retention, sharing, user rights and package terms accurately, without claiming end-to-end encryption or guaranteed GDPR compliance.
Use the appropriate lawful basis rather than blanket consent; any optional consent is separate and reversible and policy versions are recorded.

tasks.title: Confirm supplier agreements, regions and transfer safeguards
tasks.deliverable: Documented supplier and data-transfer decisions for production.
acceptance: Review app, database, backups, authentication, email, telemetry and OpenAI processing, including system metadata and operational access.
Confirm required agreements and eligibility before promising a region or retention level; record unresolved items that block real customer data.

tasks.title: Verify privacy rights and deletion end to end
tasks.deliverable: Evidence that exports, erasure, retention and sharing match the published policy.
acceptance: Use synthetic identities to exercise requests before and after account expiry, including shared snapshots and generated exports.
Verify background jobs, logs, provider deletion and restored backups; document the timing and limitations of any delayed erasure.

tasks.title: Set up staging, production and recoverable backups
inputs: Selected hosting, domain, account ownership and budget
tasks.deliverable: Reproducible deployments and tested encrypted backups in approved locations.
acceptance: Use separate environments and secrets, TLS, least-privilege access, safe migrations and a documented rollback path.
Test restoration with synthetic data, record recovery objectives, and avoid using production customer data in development or staging.

tasks.title: Configure operational metrics, alerts and incident handling
tasks.deliverable: Dashboards and thresholds for availability, speed, failures, spend and job health.
acceptance: Measure p50/p95 time to readable text and total response time separately, plus errors, rate limits, budget and deletion-job failures.
Configure recipients and response ownership without sending test messages until authorised; telemetry contains no private chat bodies.

tasks.title: Run security review and targeted penetration testing
tasks.deliverable: A documented review of the actual implementation and deployed configuration.
acceptance: Cover authentication/recovery, authorization, sharing, XSS/CSRF, prompt injection, secrets, upload ingestion, dependency risk and concurrency abuse.
Validate findings and fix release-blocking issues; retain verification evidence and explicitly record accepted residual risks.

tasks.title: Validate production-like load and cost targets
tasks.deliverable: A load and cost report using the production model, region and privacy configuration.
acceptance: Exercise realistic history sizes, concurrency, spikes, cold starts and provider rate limits using synthetic data.
Compare quality, p50/p95 first-text latency, complete-answer time and cost with the pilot; revise targets or configuration before making customer-facing commitments.

tasks.title: Run the limited invited-customer pilot
inputs: Pilot participants and approved onboarding process
tasks.deliverable: A controlled pilot with support, feedback and agreed success measures.
acceptance: Onboard a small approved group with clear terms, limits, privacy information and a support contact.
Collect quality/usability feedback and usage metrics without inspecting unshared chats; participants share content explicitly when needed for support.

tasks.title: Resolve pilot findings and confirm package economics
tasks.deliverable: A prioritised, resolved launch issue list and final package recommendation.
acceptance: Fix confirmed blockers and verify affected flows without repeating unrelated checks unnecessarily.
Use observed usage and costs to confirm prices, allowances and support assumptions; document any changes to scope or speed expectations.

tasks.title: Complete the operating runbook and handover
tasks.deliverable: Instructions for access management, knowledge updates, billing reconciliation, incidents and recovery.
acceptance: Document ownership, escalation, privacy-request handling, key rotation, backup restoration, deletion replay and rollback.
Walk through essential administrator tasks and establish maintenance, patching and support responsibilities.

tasks.title: Confirm launch readiness and release the service
tasks.deliverable: A reviewed release record and controlled production launch.
acceptance: Confirm legal/supplier, security, privacy, recovery, quality, pricing and performance requirements have evidence and no unresolved launch blocker.
Release within the owner's authorised scope, verify the production customer journey and monitor closely with a tested rollback path.

tasks.title: Add private customer document uploads if required
tasks.deliverable: Optional customer-owned attachments with a complete privacy and security lifecycle.
acceptance: Confirm this feature is needed before implementation; assess new data types, costs, retention and supplier processing.
Enforce ownership, file/type/size validation, safe parsing/scanning, bounded processing, prompt-injection handling and deletion of derived content; no customer file enters shared knowledge.

tasks.title: Automate entitlements from the external payment system
inputs: Chosen payment platform and authorised integration access
tasks.deliverable: Optional payment-event integration for package grants and renewals.
acceptance: Confirm need and provider before building; checkout remains in the external payment service.
Verify signatures and event ownership, prevent replay/duplicate grants, and define cancellation/refund/out-of-order behaviour with an audit trail.

tasks.title: Prototype customer project assignments and per-project prompts
tasks.deliverable: A synthetic demo of multiple assigned projects per customer and one prompt version per project.
acceptance: Admin can manage fictional projects/prompt versions and assign multiple projects with one valid prompt version each to a customer.
Customers see assigned projects only; switching scopes history/drafts by customer/project, and shared copies retain origin.
New chats pin the assigned prompt version; reassignment makes old chats read-only, access removal hides projects, and zero assignments has an empty state.
Preserve the monochrome design; verify desktop/mobile, meaningful regression tests and live synthetic deployment. State that Platform import/authentication are not implemented.

tasks.title: Enforce project memberships and pinned conversation routing
tasks.deliverable: Authenticated, audited project memberships with server-selected prompt and provider routing.
acceptance: Use a unique customer/project assignment and a composite foreign key to a published prompt version in that same project; provider connection/config references are restricted and versioned.
Authorize history, creation and generation by authenticated owner, active membership and entitlement; client IDs never select unauthorized prompts, credentials or another customer context.

Reassignment retains old conversation bindings and requires a new chat; project pause/revocation prevents subsequent reads/generation and later in-flight stream delivery/writes. Retention and verified privacy-rights workflows remain available.

tasks.title: Import and version project prompts in the application
inputs: Approved Platform source projects/prompts and instruction content
Authorized source access, ownership, publication and evaluation decisions
tasks.deliverable: A reviewed prompt-import/publication workflow with immutable application-owned versions and provenance.
acceptance: Verify actual supported source export/import capabilities and account access. Preserve source project/prompt/version identifiers, content checksum and approved content without exposing credentials or private instructions in customer responses.
Migrate reusable Platform prompt objects into versioned application-owned instructions before the documented 30 November 2026 shutdown; do not create a new runtime dependency on v1/prompts.
Require review and representative evaluations before publishing; new versions do not silently update memberships or existing conversations, and the previous version can be selected for rollback.

tasks.title: Verify project isolation and reassignment end to end
tasks.deliverable: Evidence for owner/project isolation, correct prompt routing, revocation and accounting in the real application.
acceptance: With synthetic users in overlapping projects, tamper owner/project/prompt/version IDs and verify private history, retrieval, caches, summaries, provider state, shares and exports never cross owner/project boundaries.
Exercise zero/multiple memberships, paused projects, invalid/cross-project prompt references, new prompt publication, reassignment and revocation during in-flight streams including delayed results.
Verify usage/cost events include the actual project and prompt/config version, switching does not reset allowance, and approved charging/retention/export/deletion rules still apply across projects.

tasks.title: Build the persistent administrator backoffice and staff sign-in
tasks.deliverable: A separate persistent administrator service with password/TOTP authentication and no default account.
acceptance: First-owner enrollment requires loopback, a server-held bootstrap secret, same-origin/CSRF checks and a short-lived setup cookie; public/proxied requests and enrollment after the first owner are denied.

Enforce password plus replay-protected TOTP, revocable hashed sessions, idle/absolute expiry, persistent failed-login limits and fresh MFA for credential changes. Password changes revoke all sessions.
Preserve the monochrome responsive UI and leave the synthetic customer demo isolated. No private customer-chat endpoint or default staff credentials are added.

tasks.title: Implement encrypted project API connections and safe key replacement
tasks.deliverable: An authenticated connection manager where Helle enters and replaces her own project keys.
acceptance: Encrypt keys server-side with a separate private master key and per-record authenticated context. Return only connection metadata and the last four key characters; exclude keys and raw provider failures from logs, errors and frontend bundles.
Check only a fixed supported HTTPS endpoint with the configured project header, timeout and redirect refusal; explain that model-list access is not generation quota or prompt-library synchronization.

Validate replacement before atomic revision-checked activation. Failure preserves the old key; pausing prevents checks, stale work cannot overwrite replacements and logout/expiry prevents pending credential writes.

tasks.title: Persist backoffice customers, projects and immutable prompt versions
tasks.deliverable: Persistent administrator-owned customer metadata, project connections and per-project prompt assignments.
acceptance: Create/edit customer name, email, account state/expiry and allowance configuration without pretending invitations, customer login or billing are active.
Support several projects per customer and an exact prompt version per project with composite foreign keys and transactional rollback on invalid/cross-project assignments.

Store reviewed manual instruction imports as immutable encrypted versions with source reference/checksum. New versions preserve assignments; configured projects cannot silently move to another provider connection.

tasks.title: Deploy and verify the isolated administrator service on jig
tasks.deliverable: An isolated Node service, scoped HTTPS proxy, private state and a verified recovery baseline.
acceptance: Use a dedicated non-login runtime user, read-only releases, loopback listener, systemd restrictions and private state outside web roots. Preserve the existing demo and unrelated sites/DNS/certificates.
Verify public HTTPS login/assets/health, denial of unauthenticated API data and public enrollment, source revision, runtime ownership and current backup.

Exercise consistent database/vault backup restoration with synthetic encrypted records; document code rollback and the remaining offsite backup/recovery/privacy gates. Handoff the first-owner form without entering real credentials for the owner.

tasks.title: Complete staff invitations, roles and verified recovery before customer pilot
tasks.deliverable: Reviewed staff lifecycle and operational recovery integrated with the later customer identity boundary.
acceptance: Define owner/admin/support permissions and enforce them server-side, including least-privilege access to provider connections and private instructions. Support revocation and safe additional-staff enrollment without a public bootstrap route.
Rehearse lost-factor/password recovery with identity verification, audit and full session revocation; never turn owner setup into a public reset path.

Complete offsite encrypted backups, retention/alerts and customer-runtime identity/storage decisions before production customer data or a pilot. Preserve customer chat privacy from staff account administration.
